tools.name: send_for_signature
tools.description: Send a PDF document for legally binding electronic signature via SignSimple (free, unlimited). Provide the PDF as a fetchable URL or base64, plus recipient name(s) and email(s). Each recipient is emailed a secure signing link; signature and date fields are placed automatically unless custom fields a

tools.name: get_document_status
tools.description: Check the status of a document previously sent for signature: overall state (sent/completed/declined/expired/voided), per-recipient progress (pending/viewed/signed), and the signed PDF download URL once complete. Requires a SignSimple API key.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List the 25 most recent documents sent from the connected SignSimple account, with status and signed-PDF URLs where complete. Requires a SignSimple API key.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List SignSimple's free, professionally drafted document templates (NDA, lease, contractor agreement, liability waiver, bill of sale, promissory note). Returns each template's info page and direct PDF URL — pass the PDF URL to send_for_signature as document_url to send one. No API key needed.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_document_status, list_documents, list_templates · Private data: send_for_signature, get_document_status, list_documents, list_templates · Public sink: send_for_signature, list_templates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_document_status, list_documents, list_templates · Private data: send_for_signature, get_document_status, list_documents, list_templates · Public sink: send_for_signature, list_templates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
